observations: Photo 0 shows a blue/black mountain bike with front suspension fork and front disc brake rotor visible.
Wheels appear to be 26-inch class (seller says 26 MTB; photo shows typical 26 MTB proportions but no readable size marking).
Brand/model text on the frame looks like 'KONG' (or similar) but is not fully clear; 'KONG' is the only readable-looking word on the frame area.
Front wheel, fork, handlebars, and drivetrain area are visible; no close-up of gear shifters/derailleurs or brake calipers.
No clear photo of the rear brake, gear cassette/derailleur condition, or frame serial/model plate.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows front suspension fork, but rear suspension/shock is not clearly visible.
Photo 0 does not show a readable wheel-size label or measurement.
Aesthetic/quality claim not provable from this single wide photo.
Tyre tread condition is not shown in close-up; no sidewall/age/tear check.
No close-up or test evidence of shifting performance or brake bite.
No clear view of adjustable seatpost/handlebar markings or adjustment range.

risks.risk: Not actually dual-suspension (may be only front suspension).
risks.proof: Photo/clip showing the rear shock/suspension linkage and rear shock mount (or a clear side view of the rear triangle).
risks.if_unproven: Price as front-suspension only (worst case vs 'dual shock').

risks.risk: Wheel size may not be 26-inch (could be 24/27.5/other).
risks.proof: Photo of the tyre sidewall showing the size marking (e.g., 26x1.95) or a measurement of rim diameter.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic 26-inch MTB only if confirmed; otherwise price as the most common lower-value mismatch case.

risks.risk: Tyres may be worn, cracked, or need replacement soon.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both tyres (tread depth, cracks, sidewall damage) and a photo of the inner tube/valve area if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as tyres needing replacement soon.

risks.risk: Gears may not shift correctly (bent derailleur, worn cassette/chain, misadjustment).
risks.proof: Video of shifting through all gears while pedaling, plus close-up of derailleur and chain condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as gears not fully working (worst case).

risks.risk: Brakes may be weak or require service (pads worn, rotor warped, cable issues).
risks.proof: Video of hard braking from a short roll + close-up of brake pads and rear brake setup.
risks.if_unproven: Price as brakes not fully working (worst case).

risks.risk: Frame size/fit may not match 'Size 26' (could be wrong frame size for buyer).
risks.proof: Photo of the frame size marking (if any) and a measurement from seat tube top to center (or seat tube length).
risks.if_unproven: Price as average/unknown fit (no premium for correct sizing).

proof_requests: Clear side photo showing whether there is a rear shock (dual suspension) and the rear linkage.
Close-up of tyre sidewalls showing the exact size marking.
Video: shift through all gears while pedaling (front and rear derailleur visible).
Video: brake test (front and rear) showing strong bite and no rubbing.
Close-up photos of chain, cassette/freewheel, derailleur condition, and brake pads/rotors.
response.reason: From photo 0, it’s a 26-inch class MTB with front suspension, but key claims (dual shock, tyre condition, gears/brakes working) are not verifiable remotely without close-ups and test videos. Missing proof prevents a confident worst-case price.
